what: MM1 residuals: every residual of the lab matmul models on data they did not fit, their systematic misses and the floor
label: POST HOC (desk arithmetic of committed forecasts and measured records; no group here was registered before any datum)

conventions.J over idle pools: points at 3 W over idle and above (the lab scorers' rule)
conventions.given seconds: W_g = A + (W_f - A) t_f / t_meas (the model's own affine form); E208 UNREAD rows: the scorer's given-t column
conventions.cluster: one case (shape, format, mask) on one card
conventions.held out sets: MM1-v2 refitted without the point's experiment (LOEO) or card (LOCO); J in units of the measured seconds
conventions.frontier: E206A: v2-LOEO; E206B: v1-E206B; E207: v2-E207; E208: v2-LOEO; older (E105-E190): v2-LOEO

named_misses_definitions.T1a int8 1x1x1 at about 800 MHz: int8 gemmL1x1x1 with a measured kernel clock of 790 MHz or more
named_misses_definitions.T1c fp32 or fp16 at one K block, MB x NB: fp32 or fp16, KB = 1, MB x NB >= 2
named_misses_definitions.T9 the governed clock (about 800 MHz), o: measured kernel clock 790 MHz or more (aifoundry2 card 0, aifoundry1 card 0), int8 1x1x1 apart
named_misses_definitions.E3 zero data on the governed cards: all-zero operands, aifoundry2 card 0 or aifoundry1 card 0
named_misses_definitions.E9 ones data: a repeated tile of 1.0 (MM1-v0 and MM1-v1 forecast no energy for it)

crosscheck_published.source: mm1v0-e206, all 109 points (W under 3 W included)

die_check.what: J over idle given t (data not zero) against the die at the run's start: slope of e in % per C; the lab's die correction is +0.48% of power per C (E208's reduction), so a model without a die term reads about -0.5% per C

experiment_offsets.what: the share of the pool's mean square error held by each measured experiment's mean error (in sample; a session or campaign term no size or operation can forecast)

T9 the governed clock (about 800 MHz), o.definition: measured kernel clock 790 MHz or more (aifoundry2 card 0, aifoundry1 card 0), int8 1x1x1 apart

E3 zero data on the governed cards.definition: all-zero operands, aifoundry2 card 0 or aifoundry1 card 0

E9 ones data.definition: a repeated tile of 1.0 (MM1-v0 and MM1-v1 forecast no energy for it)
